EmailTemplate.subject: ASU School of Music - Graduate Diagnostic Exams
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear {!Contact.FirstName},
Our records indicate that you have not completed the following Graduate Diagnostic Exams:
Music History Music Theory
The School of Music requires all graduate students to complete the diagnostic exams by the start of their second semester of study. A hold has been placed on your My ASU preventing you from registering for fall 2016, until the exams are completed.
The diagnostic exams are accessible online through your personal computer. Please visit this website to start the exam: http://music.asu.edu/admissions/grad/exams.php. After you complete the exams, the hold will be removed from your My ASU account.
Sincerely,
Julie Stephens Coordinator, Academic Affairs + Admissions Arizona State University | Herberger Institute for Design and the Arts P.O. Box 870405 | Tempe, Arizona 85287-0405 Phone: 480-965-5069 {!Case.Thread_Id}
